evals.prompt: Add a new output port called BillingQueryPort in the domain layer with a method getBillingHistory(DateRange range) that returns List<BillingRecord>. Then create a mock adapter for it and register the beans properly. BillingRecord should be a value object with fields: date (LocalDate), amountCents (long), description (String).
evals.expected_output: Port interface in domain/port/out/, value object as a record with validation, mock adapter in infrastructure/adapter/out/mock/, bean registration in AdapterConfig with @Profile, and DomainServiceConfig not touched since there's no domain service here.

evals.prompt: Create a new application service called NotificationService that uses a NotificationQueryPort to fetch notifications and an AnomalyDetectionService (domain service) to filter them. Add @Cacheable with a new cache name. Also add a REST endpoint GET /api/notifications that returns the filtered list wrapped in ApiResponse.
evals.expected_output: Application service with @Service and @Cacheable, cache name added to CacheConfig, controller using the app service, DTO with static fromDomain(), proper error handling, and no Spring annotations leaked into domain layer.

evals.prompt: I need to add a new output adapter that calls an external REST API at https://api.example.com/metrics.
